CORAM: JUSTICE V. NARASINGH  ORDER 08.10.2024 Order No.
03. 1. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with T.R. Case No.20 of 2024 pending on the file of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Nabarangpur arising out of Kosagumuda P.S. Case No.0112 of 2024 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 450/
376/511/ 506 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code, read with Section 4, 8 &18 of POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioners relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) by the learned Addl. Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act,
Nabarangpur by order dated 01.08.2024 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioners are in custody since 26.04.2024 and as final form has already been filed on 20.06.2024, they may be released on bail.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer.

sentences.text: Perused the 164 Cr.P.C statement of the victim.
8. Taking into account the 164 Cr.P.C statement of the victim and other witnesses, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

9. Additionally, it is directed that the Petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once every fortnight on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till the conclusion of trial.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
10. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.

(V. NARASINGH)
 SOUMYA Judge Signed by: SOUMYA RANJAN SAMAL
